description: This file declares functions and data structures for data conversion and handling in the he_bus module of the project. It includes function prototypes for converting raw message data, decoding and handling data, preparing message headers, and managing object data within the he_bus data bus system. It also contains include directives and license information.

methods.name: convert_bus_raw_msg_data_to_buffer
methods.description: Converts raw bus message data into a buffer.

methods.name: convert_buffer_to_bus_raw_msg_data
methods.description: Converts a buffer back into bus raw message data.

methods.name: decode_and_handle_data
methods.description: Decodes incoming data and performs handling based on the data.

methods.name: send_bus_initial_msg_info
methods.description: Sends initial message info over the bus.

methods.name: handle_bus_msg_data
methods.description: Handles bus message data and responses.

methods.name: set_bus_object_data
methods.description: Sets data for a bus object based on an event.

methods.name: prepare_initial_bus_header
methods.description: Prepares the initial header for a bus message.

methods.name: prepare_rem_payload_bus_msg_data
methods.description: Prepares the remaining payload data for a bus message.

methods.name: get_total_size_from_he_bus_raw_data
methods.description: Calculates total size from raw data.

methods.name: get_total_objs_size_from_he_bus_objs
methods.description: Calculates total size from bus data objects.

methods.name: memory_alloc_for_he_bus_data_obj
methods.description: Allocates memory for a bus data object.

methods.name: he_bus_data_object_retain
methods.description: Retains a reference to a bus data object.

methods.name: move_multi_objs_data
methods.description: Moves data between message and data objects.
